_note: Copied to .mcu-profile.json by /scaffold-mcu-project telink. Requires the Telink SDK mounted at /opt/telink/sdk. Full key reference: `mcu --schema`.

_flashTool_guidance.tlsr: Community SWire tools from $TLSR_TOOLS (pvvx/TLSRPGM). Requires dedicated programmer hardware (TB-04-KIT or TLSR8269 running the TLSRPGM firmware), not just a USB-serial adapter. Verify the exact flags with `python3 $TLSR_TOOLS/TlsrPgm.py --help` before trusting these defaults.
_flashTool_guidance.bdt: Telink's official Burning and Debugging Tool. Windows GUI only — run it on the host, not here.
_flashTool_guidance._note: Unlike the arm and wch leaves there is no first-class, well-supported CLI flasher for TC32. Verify your setup on a scratch board before relying on it.

build: test -x ${SDK}/tools/tc32/bin/tc32-elf-gcc || { echo 'ERROR: Telink SDK not mounted at ${SDK}. Run dev-up.sh with the SDK present, or -v ~/telink/Telink_825X_SDK:/opt/telink/sdk:ro' >&2; exit 1; }; make -j$(nproc) -C ${SDK_PROJECT:-.} TC32_PATH=${SDK}/tools/tc32
buildDebug: test -x ${SDK}/tools/tc32/bin/tc32-elf-gcc || { echo 'ERROR: Telink SDK not mounted at ${SDK}.' >&2; exit 1; }; make -j$(nproc) -C ${SDK_PROJECT:-.} TC32_PATH=${SDK}/tools/tc32 DEBUG=1
hostTest: cmake -S . -B build-host -G Ninja -DHOST_TESTS=ON && cmake --build build-host && ctest --test-dir build-host --output-on-failure
flash: test -f ${TLSR_TOOLS}/TlsrPgm.py || { echo "ERROR: TlsrPgm.py not found under ${TLSR_TOOLS}. In-container flashing needs pvvx/TLSRPGM plus SWire programmer hardware; otherwise flash from the host with Telink BDT." >&2; exit 1; }; python3 ${TLSR_TOOLS}/TlsrPgm.py -p${PORT:-/dev/ttyUSB0} -b${PGM_BAUD:-230400} -s -m we ${FLASH_ADDR:-0} ${BIN:-build/firmware.bin}
erase: test -f ${TLSR_TOOLS}/TlsrPgm.py || { echo "ERROR: TlsrPgm.py not found under ${TLSR_TOOLS}. In-container flashing needs pvvx/TLSRPGM plus SWire programmer hardware; otherwise flash from the host with Telink BDT." >&2; exit 1; }; python3 ${TLSR_TOOLS}/TlsrPgm.py -p${PORT:-/dev/ttyUSB0} -b${PGM_BAUD:-230400} -s es 0 0x80000
reset: test -f ${TLSR_TOOLS}/TlsrPgm.py || { echo "ERROR: TlsrPgm.py not found under ${TLSR_TOOLS}. In-container flashing needs pvvx/TLSRPGM plus SWire programmer hardware; otherwise flash from the host with Telink BDT." >&2; exit 1; }; python3 ${TLSR_TOOLS}/TlsrPgm.py -p${PORT:-/dev/ttyUSB0} -b${PGM_BAUD:-230400} -m i
debugServer: echo 'TC32 has no supported in-container GDB server. Telink debugging goes through BDT on Windows, or printf/UART tracing.' >&2; exit 1
